_notes: Cut at 2.8 s (frame 14). Shot 0: A at x 400, alternating until frame 12, flat on 13. Shot 1: C at x 1300, flat until frame 20, alternating from 21. Voice 0.5 everywhere.
Tracks reset at the cut, so C is a new person (p2). Lips only use the same shot's sightings: A's frame 13 window is 0.1, 0.1 -> 0.

Frames 0-12: A. Frames 13-19: voice, no candidate: voice-only (2.6 s to 4.0 s = 1.4 s > 1 s). Frame 20: C is a candidate (its window has 0.1, 0.1, 0.3) and A isn't in this shot, so C takes over at once.
Segments before snapping: A [0, 2.6 s), voice [2.6 s, 4.0 s), C [4.0 s, 6.0 s). The edge at 2.6 s is 0.2 s from the cut (< 0.4 s), so it moves to 2.8 s.

Window for 1920x1080 to 9:16: h = min(1080, floor(1920*1920/1080)) = 1080, w = round(1080*1080/1920) = round(607.5) = 608, so a centre x lies in [304, 1616] and y is always 540 (the window is as tall as the frame).
A face at x = 400 (w 200) has its centre at 500; at x = 1300, at 1400.
